newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Enterprises, Enova launch JV.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Enterprises, Enova launch JV.

text.p: Pacific Enterprises and Enova Corp announced Thursday the launch of Energy Pacific, a joint venture to provide integrated energy services and products in California and throughout the U.S.

Pacific Enterprises, the parent of Southern California Gas Co, and Enova, parent of San Diego Gas & Electric Co, announced late last year plans to merge, but final federal approval of the deal is still pending.
The joint venture incorporates several existing unregulated businesses from each company.

Enova Energy, Inc and Enova Technologies as well as Pacific Enterprises Energy Management Services, Pacific Enterprises LNG Co, Pacific Energy Leasing Co, Energy Alliance I and Ensource are now part of the joint venture.
Eric Nelson, a Pacific Enterprises senior vice president, was named president of the Los Angeles-based venture.
Nelson said the venture will first "focus on establishing a platform to become a strong regional retail energy provider."

The companies, which expect their merger to complete their merger by the end of 1997, said Energy Pacific may expand its scale and market presence through alliances, joint ventures or acquisitions over the next several months.
